text:
alex: heads-up: noticed ~3x token/sec drop on canary after today's release (release/2026-03-17). telemetry shows sustained queueing delays.
ci-bot: perf-test/canary reported: token/sec down 64% vs baseline, p95 latency +180ms. link: https://ci.internal/tests/9876 :rotating_light:
priya: logs or profiler output? can you paste the top hotpaths?
jason: if it's token/sec drop + queueing, could be batching heuristics or kernel selection fallback.
alex: profiler snapshot pasted below — large jump in continuous_batcher wait and kernel fallback path being used a lot: ```
[perf_summary]
avg_token_sec=420 -> 150
scheduler.wait_ms_p50: 8.2 -> 37.9
batch_size_p50: 4 -> 2
kv_cache.hit_rate: 0.82 -> 0.30
kernel_selected: opt_fwd_v2 -> generic_fwd
stack: runtime/scheduler.go:312 continuous_batcher.wait -> runtime/kernel/selector.go:87 fallback_path
```
marta: that looks like the new kernel-threshold change maybe. PR #2345 merged earlier today changed the memory estimate heuristic.
priya: running a quick bisect: rolling canary back one commit to see if it recovers.
infra-bot: initiated rollback to commit abc123 on canary (job id: rollback-1782504400).
alex: after rollback token/sec returned to ~410, queueing back down. regression between abc123..def456.
priya: confirmed bisection narrowed to merge 'adaptive-kernel-threshold' (def456). I'm preparing a revert PR and a short-term pin.
jason: note KV cache hit rate also tanked in the same window — batching distribution changed so fewer requests reused KV prefixes. suspect batching heuristic tweak in the same PR.
alex: quick repro if anyone wants to reproduce locally: ```
# run short loadtest to reproduce T/sec drop
./tools/loadtest --model redwood-v1 --seq 2048 --qps 50 --duration 3m --metrics scheduler.wait hist,kv.hitrate
```
marta: filing rollback PR and blocking the release until we have a patched kernel selector and updated batching tests. /cc @eng-releases
priya: short-term patch: revert threshold change + add a guard that pins opt_fwd_v2 when mem_est < 12GB and seq_len dist matches historical pattern. also adding unit test for kernel selection with synthetic seq distributions.
jason: also adding an e2e perf check in CI guard that asserts token/sec stays within 10% of baseline under canonical load.
deploy-bot: canary rollback completed at 1782504688. triggering release hold flag.
alex: thanks all. follow-up: we should add telemetry to flag sudden KV hit-rate shifts and kernel-fallback frequency so future regressions are auto-detected before rollouts. :+1:
